verdict.rationale: The Search API is documented as offering "content extraction" and "controls for... extracted content" (docs-17, docs-52), and the Agent API includes a built-in URL fetch tool (docs-30). However, nothing shows that full page text or markdown is returned to the developer. The CLI describes its output as "query-relevant page snippets" (docs-24), and URL fetch output appears to feed the model's answer rather than reach the developer as a raw document. missing for 10: documented full-page text/markdown output field, explicit control over extraction length/format, response schema showing full content, hands-on corroboration.
